title: copilot repair --json (SPECULATIVE -- control-tower's assumed shape, pending upstream definition)
description: Result of a layer-role-split repair: org/dept/foundation mirrors get fetch+reset --hard/reclone; the personal layer gets stash-and-flag (never discard). SPECULATIVE: `repair` is NOT one of the upstream WS-A verb tasks (06-control-tower-prd.md §3 lists only A1 doctor, A2 update, A3 resolve/deprovision/freshness -- there is no A-task defining a `repair --json` payload). `repair` IS invoked as a CLI command by Control Tower, but it is driven by the `repair` TOKEN returned per-checker on `doctor --json` (each checker's `repair` field, e.g. `git pull --ff-only`, echoed back so the app can call `copilot repair --only <checker.id>` -- see doctor.schema.json / design-control-tower-integration.md §1.1). This file is control-tower's own assumed shape for that invocation's response, reconstructed from architecture.md's repair semantics, NOT an authoritative WS-A contract. Do not treat it as frozen; it must be reconciled with (or superseded by) whatever payload the CLI actually emits once WS-A defines `repair --json`, if it ever does.
$comment: IMPORTANT: cli-contract.md does NOT specify a --json shape for `repair` (the verb is consumed and participates in flock serialization, but no payload is enumerated), and neither does the upstream design (05-control-tower.md, 06-control-tower-prd.md, design-control-tower-integration.md) -- none of the three upstream documents define a `repair --json` schema; repair is described only as the per-checker `repair` token on `doctor`. This schema is a defensible reconstruction from architecture.md/ecosystem-architecture.md §5.2 repair semantics (A-H11: mirrors reset/reclone, personal stash-and-flag-never-discard). additionalProperties is left true and this file MUST be tightened/frozen -- or dropped in favor of the CLI's real payload -- once/if the CLI publishes it.

result.$comment: Value set unspecified in the contract; left as a non-empty string.

role.$comment: Reconstructed role split (mirror vs personal vs foundation) from the split-by-layer-role repair design; not an enumerated field in cli-contract.md.

op.$comment: Reconstructed op set: mirrors reset/reclone, personal stash-flag (never discard), else unchanged. Not enumerated in cli-contract.md.

retained_dirty.description: Human-owned/dirty trees that were preserved (never-destroy invariant #3). Mirrors deprovision.retained_dirty.
